title: Research Query Coverage
description: The auditable coverage record for research-evidence queries. It records declared query outcomes and provenance; it does not perform retrieval or decide a report verdict.

branch_id.description: Stable identifier for the ARIS research branch whose evidence coverage is recorded.

source_policy.description: The declared provenance policy for this coverage record. Anti records the policy but performs no retrieval.

counter_query_run.description: Whether the branch recorded an opposing counter-query run; optional for legacy coverage records.

queries.description: One entry for each research-evidence query considered by the branch.

query.description: The recorded query text, when one exists.

status.description: Terminal state of the query record.

evidence_directions.description: How the recorded evidence bears on the claim or question.

source.description: Declared source or provenance label for the query result.

evidence_item_keys.description: Stable keys for evidence items associated with this query.

notes.description: Optional bounded explanation of the query outcome.

artifact_hashes.description: Mapping from recorded artifact keys or paths to their content hashes.
